# Horizon Web Corp — Full Knowledge Base & Technical Architecture

> Official extended documentation for AI agents, generative search engines, and automated knowledge systems.
> Canonical Domain: https://horizonwebcorp.com
> Primary Entity: Horizon Web Corp (Experiential Web Design & Engineering Studio)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity

Horizon Web Corp is a boutique digital engineering studio specialized in designing and developing bespoke, high-performance web applications. The studio serves venture-backed startups, modern enterprise brands, and premium consumer goods companies across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Unlike mass-market agencies that rely on visual builders such as Webflow, WordPress, Wix, or Shopify themes, Horizon Web Corp writes 100% custom, production-grade code. Every deployment is architected in Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and custom WebGL/Three.js shaders.

### Key Differentiators:
- **No Templates / No Builders**: Zero code bloat from visual page builders; all styles are compiled to atomic CSS.
- **SLA-Backed Performance**: Every build is guaranteed to achieve sub-0.8s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and audited 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- **Hardware-Accelerated 3D Motion**: 60 frames per second spatial interactivity powered by Three.js and custom GLSL vertex/fragment shaders.
- **Full WCAG 2.2 AA Compliance**: Dark-tech aesthetics engineered with mathematically verified color contrast ratios and keyboard navigation traps eliminated.

---

## 2. Engineering Stack & Standards

### Frontend Core:
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (React 19, Server Components, Streaming SSR, Turbopack)
- **Language**: TypeScript (Strict typing enabled across all modules)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom design tokens and semantic variables
- **Motion & Interaction**: Framer Motion (GPU transform-only animations), Lenis Smooth Scroll
- **Spatial Graphics**: Three.js, WebGL 2.0, WebGPU / TSL (Three.js Shading Language)

### Performance SLA & Quality Metrics:
- **First Contentful Paint (FCP)**: < 0.6 seconds
- **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)**: < 0.8 seconds
- **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)**: 0.000 (Locked layout dimensions)
- **Interaction to Next Paint (INP)**: < 35 milliseconds
- **Bundle Optimization**: Dynamic route-based code splitting, dynamic dynamic() imports for heavy 3D canvases, Brotli compression.

---

## 3. Core Service Catalog

### Service 1: Bespoke UI/UX & Design Systems
- Development of scalable design tokens (primitive -> semantic -> component layers).
- Architectural typography scales, micro-interactions, accessible color palettes, and editorial bento layouts.
- Output: Production-ready React component libraries and design tokens.

### Service 2: Interactive 3D & WebGL Engineering
- Three.js product showcases, interactive globes, spatial galaxy particle systems, and kinetic scroll physics.
- Custom GLSL shader development (holographic effects, chromatic aberration, fluid noise, procedural geometry).
- Frame budget: 16.6ms per frame (60 FPS) guaranteed with strict draw-call batching.

### Service 3: Performance Engineering & Headless Architecture
- Migrations from slow legacy platforms (WordPress, Magento, legacy SPAs) to headless Next.js architectures.
- Sub-second edge caching, streaming SSR, and automated Lighthouse audit optimization.

## 4. Case Studies & Verification Proof

### Case Study: The Swiss Waffle Co.
- **Sector**: Food, Beverage & Quick Service Restaurants
- **Stack**: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Deliverables**: Bespoke digital ordering storefront, interactive menu carousel with fluid item previews, and dessert brand aesthetic.
- **Metrics**: 99.8% Core Web Vitals pass rate, 420ms average page load, +45% conversion uplift on digital orders.

### Case Study: Jeevan Rekha Foods (AB Udyog)
- **Sector**: FMCG & Edible Oils Manufacturing
- **Stack**: Next.js App Router, WebGL Backgrounds, Accessible UI
- **Deliverables**: Corporate manufacturing portal representing a multi-decade industrial legacy with modern high-contrast editorial layouts.
- **Metrics**: Sub-500ms initial paint across mobile 4G networks, 100/100 Accessibility score.

### Case Study: Skyscape Photography
- **Sector**: Creative Arts & Photography
- **Stack**: Next.js, Three.js, Custom WebGL Shader
- **Deliverables**: Full-screen cinematic gallery with interactive mouse-inertia scrolling and high-resolution picture delivery via responsive edge image pipelines.

### Case Study: Synapse AI Vault
- **Sector**: Enterprise AI & Cyber Defense
- **Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js Particle Mesh
- **Deliverables**: Cybernetic dark-mode dashboard with real-time agent topology graph visualizer.

## 5. Technical Research Journals

1. **The WebGL Renaissance: Bridging Spatial Artistry and Frontend Performance**
   - *Summary*: Why modern web design is transitioning from flat 2D cards to spatial 3D interactive canvases, and how to optimize GPU draw calls to maintain 60 FPS on mobile browsers.
   - *Link*: https://horizonwebcorp.com/blogs/webgl-renaissance

2. **Next.js 16 and RSC: Achieving Sub-Second Page Latency**
   - *Summary*: Technical breakdown of React Server Components (RSC), server-side streaming, hydration cost elimination, and reaching 100/100 Lighthouse scores.
   - *Link*: https://horizonwebcorp.com/blogs/nextjs-rsc-latency

3. **The Physics of Motion Design: Crafting Custom Scroll & Cursor Easing**
   - *Summary*: Why default linear and ease-in-out animations feel generic, and how custom cubic-bezier curves, inertia springs, and canvas tracking create luxury tactile experiences.
   - *Link*: https://horizonwebcorp.com/blogs/motion-design-physics

4. **WCAG AA Compliance in High-Contrast Luxury Design Systems**
   - *Summary*: Reconciling dark-tech 'cold luxury' aesthetics with strict accessibility standards, calculating color contrast ratios, and implementing bypass blocks.
   - *Link*: https://horizonwebcorp.com/blogs/accessibility-luxury-design

5. **WebGPU vs WebGL: The Next Frontier of Real-Time Browser Compute**
   - *Summary*: Comparing OpenGL ES WebGL architectures with modern WebGPU compute pipelines, TSL (Three.js Shading Language), and client-side simulation.
   - *Link*: https://horizonwebcorp.com/blogs/webgpu-vs-webgl

6. **Edge Caching & Global CDNs: Scalable Infrastructure for High-Traffic Drops**
   - *Summary*: Architecture patterns for deploying interactive web applications across globally distributed edge nodes with Brotli pre-compression and strict cache invalidation.
   - *Link*: https://horizonwebcorp.com/blogs/edge-caching-infrastructure

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What makes Horizon Web Corp different from standard web design agencies?
Horizon Web Corp does not use visual website builders, off-the-shelf templates, or pre-packaged themes. Every project is engineered from scratch in Next.js, TypeScript, and custom CSS/WebGL, ensuring unmatched rendering speed, custom interaction physics, and clean codebase ownership.

### What is Horizon Web Corp's turnaround time for client builds?
Typical enterprise and startup projects are completed within 4 to 8 weeks. Every project undergoes a 4-phase delivery methodology: Strategic Discovery, Interactive Prototyping, Production-Grade Engineering, and Edge Deployment with Performance Verification.

### How does 3D WebGL impact mobile performance and battery life?
Horizon Web Corp implements GPU-efficient rendering pipelines: low-polygon geometry, shader optimization, viewport-intersection pausing (so WebGL stops rendering when scrolled out of view), and responsive asset downsizing for low-powered mobile devices.

### Where is Horizon Web Corp located?
Horizon Web Corp is headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, and operates as a global engineering studio serving clients across the United States, Europe, the United Kingdom, India, and the UAE.

### How can a business initiate a project?
Inquiries can be submitted directly via the interactive contact portal at https://horizonwebcorp.com/#contact or by contacting the engineering leadership team. The studio accepts four primary client deployments per quarter.
